pairing_note: The counted statement is the author's proposition environment at source lines 38808-38829 (label proposition-splitting, whose reference environment records Serre, Theorem 2): in the situation of the module with its value spaces over a Noetherian space, given sections, a closed subset and points with prescribed values, and an integer k bounded by the dimensions of the value spaces, there is a section taking the prescribed values whose vanishing locus together with the given closed subset contains the zero locus of the extended family and whose complement has all components of codimension at least k. The statement uses the notation of the author's situation environment at lines 38720-38728, which is carried in the card as a context span so the reader sees what the module, the value spaces and the dimension function are.
